schedule.comment: slots[] is the single source of truth for the 12-post rotation. bot/schedule.py serves pending slots in order across UTC dates; midnight never restarts an unfinished rotation. Cron targets 12 runs/day, but delayed runs may span days. hour_utc is a nominal label only. Automatic runs preserve the mix; explicit type/slot requests or reset can publish extras.

trending.comment: If the strict momentum filter yields no postable coin, the change threshold is relaxed through min_change_fallbacks before the run gives up. A softer verified setup is still a better post than a missed slot.
trending.score_comment: Composite topic score: 24h momentum, intraday range, quote volume, trade count (audience relevance) and a novelty bonus decaying over 7 days since the coin was last posted. Selection picks the highest-scoring unblocked candidate, not just the top gainer.

content.comment: CTA mix was 65/20/10/5; research shows content-specific questions earn the most replies, so the question share rises and questions are built from the post's own scenario levels instead of generic prompts.

monitor.comment: Verified outcome honesty: stop-loss resolutions and thesis-under-pressure updates are published from the candle-scanned ledger (sl_posts capped per UTC day to protect the feed; the weekly scorecard still counts every outcome). pressure_zone_fraction is the share of the entry->stop distance that counts as 'near invalidation'.
